headline: Jogorku Kenesh deputy proposes restricting loans to citizens under 21 years of age
summary: A Kyrgyz deputy of the Jogorku Kenesh proposed considering limits on issuing loans to citizens younger than 21. The proposal is at the discussion stage.
why: Lending rules set by regulators determine credit access for borrowers and shape consumer lending risk for banks and microfinance lenders.
original_headline: Депутат ЖК предложил ограничить выдачу кредитов гражданам младше 21 года
